बॉलिवुड के गलियारों से आ गई है एकदम चटपटी खबर! 🔥
Koffee With Karan Season 9 के लेटेस्ट एपिसोड में वरुण धवन ने मारा बड़ा बयान।
शो के रैपिड-फायर राउंड में करण जौहर ने पूछा था कि Animal के रणबीर कपूर या Dhurandhar के रणवीर सिंह में से किसकी परफॉर्मेंस ज्यादा impactful है।
बिना किसी झिझक के वरुण का जवाब था कि उन्हें Dhurandhar में रणवीर सिंह की एक्टिंग ज्यादा दमदार लगी। 😎
रिपोर्ट्स के मुताबिक, Animal फिल्म 915 करोड़ रुपये की कमाई के साथ बॉक्स-ऑफिस पर बहुत बड़ी सक्सेस रही थी, हालांकि फिल्म पर महिलाओं को लेकर और टॉक्सिक मैस्क्यूलिनिटी को बढ़ावा देने के आरोप भी लगे थे।
वहीं दूसरी तरफ, Dhurandhar franchise ने दुनियाभर में 1300 करोड़ रुपये से ज्यादा कमाए और Dhurandhar The Revenge ने ग्लोबल लेवल पर 1800 करोड़ रुपये कमाकर इतिहास रच दिया।
अब आपको क्या लगता है, रणवीर का सीक्रेट एजेंट अवतार बेहतर था या रणबीर का एंग्री यंग मैन अंदाज? 🍿
कमेंट करके अपनी राय जरूर बताओ! 👇

ctx.title: Ranveer Singh's performance in Dhurandhar was more impactful than Ranbir Kapoor in Animal, feels Varun Dhawan
ctx.summary: Varun Dhawan backed Ranveer Singh in Dhurandhar over Ranbir Kapoor in Animal during a rapid-fire round on Koffee With Karan Season 9.
ctx.text:
Ranbir Kapoor and Ranveer Singh have both impressed audiences with their performances in recent years, with Animal and Dhurandhar emerging as major box-office successes. But when asked to choose between the two actors for the more impactful performance, Varun Dhawan did not hesitate to pick a winner.
The latest episode of Koffee With Karan Season 9 featured Janhvi Kapoor and Varun Dhawan as guests, with Arjun Kapoor joining them for the rapid-fire round. During the segment, Karan Johar asked Varun, "Ranveer Singh in Dhurandhar or Ranbir Kapoor in Animal, which one is a more impactful performance?" Without hesitation, Varun replied, "I would definitely say Ranveer in Dhurandhar."
Interestingly, in the first episode of Koffee With Karan Season 9, Karan was asked to choose between Ranbir and Ranveer to decide who was the more versatile actor. He responded, "You don't choose between brilliance."
Ranbir delivered one of the most talked-about performances of his career with Sandeep Reddy Vanga’s Animal (2023). Playing Ranvijay Singh, a man whose complicated relationship with his father drives him towards violence and revenge, the actor showcased an intense side of his acting. Despite the film facing criticism for its portrayal of women and glorification of toxic masculinity, his performance received widespread attention. Animal also became a major box-office success, collecting ₹ 915 crore worldwide.
Now, Ranbir is awaiting the release of Ramayana, a film mounted on a massive budget of ₹ 4000 crore. The mythological epic, directed by Nitesh Tiwari, also stars Sai Pallavi, Yash, Sunny Deol, and Ravie Dubey, among others. The film will be released in two parts, with the first one releasing on November 5, 2026.
With Aditya Dhar’s Dhurandhar franchise, Ranveer moved away from his trademark flamboyance to deliver a restrained and intense performance. As Hamza Ali Mazari, an Indian spy operating undercover in Pakistan, Ranveer won over the fans with his performance and physical transformation. The franchise became a major box-office phenomenon. While Dhurandhar earned over ₹ 1300 crore worldwide, Dhurandhar The Revenge became the first Indian film to breach the ₹ 1000 crore mark at the domestic box office, earning ₹ 1800 crore globally.
According to reports, Varun will lead the next film by Maamla Legal Hai director Rahul Pandey. The yet-untitled film is said to be backed by Karan Johar's Dharma Productions. However, an official confirmation is still awaited. Varun also has Bhediya 2 in the pipeline. The actor announced the film in 2023, and it was expected to release in 2025. Fans are still awaiting an update on the movie.
